Had a wonderful experience at **Bengaluru Brahmins Cafe!** 😍 The benne masale dosa was absolutely delicious, and the filter coffee was the perfect way to finish the meal. ☕ The cafe was also clean and hygienic, which made the experience even better. Truly loved the food and the ambience — definitely worth a visit! ❤️ …
The food was delicious, authentic and full of traditional flavours. Great place to enjoy authentic Brahmin style food. Coffee is must trying
